NATURE CLUB

The wild side of the school.

One collection is open, with more to come: the Animals class — the deeper deck after Animal Categories, where the big families give way to the specialists: birds of prey, crustaceans, pollinators, the dog family, rodents and the wild homes of six habitats.

The Nature Club is the school’s wild side — spotter classes for children who want to know what exactly was that? One collection is open, with more to come: grab a card, take the walk, and meet the wild where it actually lives.

NATURE CLUB CLASS

Animals

Twenty-two deeper animal spotter sheets — birds of prey, garden and desert birds, coastal and river animals, crustaceans and shellfish, pollinators, invertebrates, the dog family, deer and grazers, rodents, and six wild homes — each with its own spotter lesson a kid can follow.

Open the Animals class ↗

Start with the Animal Categories extra class first if the animal families are new — then come here for the deeper deck. Every Nature Club card keeps its printable twin in the flashcards library.
